name: The Westin Austin Downtown
positioning: Downtown Austin Westin less than a block from 6th Street, known for Azul Rooftop, its pool and lounge 20 floors above downtown
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to 6th Street's live music and nightlife
Convention-goers wanting a short walk to the Austin Convention Center

facts.text: The hotel is less than a block from 6th Street.
The Texas Capitol is less than a mile from the hotel.
The Austin Convention Center is a three-minute walk from the hotel.
Azul Rooftop is located 20 floors above downtown.
Shaded private cabanas at Azul Rooftop include sofa seating, privacy curtains, a ceiling fan and towel service.
Rooms have the Heavenly Bed and the Heavenly Shower.
Skipjack Oyster, inside the hotel, serves fresh oysters, coastal-inspired dishes and weekend brunch.
Dogs up to 70 pounds are welcome.
The hotel provides dogs with a Heavenly dog bed, a dog bowl, waste bags, doggy beer and treats.
A wagWestin map features three doggy routes and nearby doggy destinations.

highlights.text: Azul Rooftop's daytime pool scene turns into an upscale rooftop lounge with fire pits at sunset.
Transparent panels surround the Azul rooftop deck, which has views across the cityscape.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city views and artwork inspired by downtown Austin's live music tradition.
One-bedroom suites have downtown views from the living room, table seating for four, and a separate shower and spa tub.
The 20th-floor WestinWORKOUT fitness studio has a bird's-eye view of downtown Austin.

considerations.text: The rooftop deck is open to both hotel guests and the public.
Minors under 21 must be accompanied by an adult hotel guest at the pool, as there is no lifeguard on duty.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
